sourceArchives.mapping-diagnostic-run.py:
import hashlib, json, os, signal, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
plan = json.loads((p / 'screen-v2/provenance.json').read_text())
dll = p / 'mapping-diagnostic-build/CombatSolver.dll'
plan.update(scope='Actual source-registration categories; diagnostic instrumentation; no performance acceptance',
            candidateDll=str(dll), candidateDllSha256=hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            sequence=['diagnostic'], diagnostics=True)
root = p / 'mapping-diagnostic'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root / 'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
(p / 'mapping-diagnostic-source.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'CombatSolver.csproj', 'src/Engine/Common/PredictionForking.cs', 'src/Search/SimulatedCombatState.Fork.cs']))
(p / 'mapping-diagnostic-build-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='Passed', warnings=0, errors=0, elapsedSeconds=15.49, dll=str(dll), sha256=plan['candidateDllSha256']), indent=2) + '\n')
build_result = json.loads((p / 'production-v2-build-result.json').read_text())
build_result['elapsedSeconds'] = 15.28
(p / 'production-v2-build-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(build_result, indent=2) + '\n')
for scene in plan['roots']:
    out = root / scene
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for k in list(env):
        if k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY', 'DOTNET_Jit', 'COMPlus_Jit')) or k in ('DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE', 'FORK_MAPPING_PROBE_OUTPUT'):
            env.pop(k)
    env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
    env['FORK_MAPPING_PROBE_OUTPUT'] = str(out / 'mapping-categories.json')
    args = ['dotnet', plan['host'], '--request', plan['requestDirectory'] + '/' + scene + '.json', '--label', scene + '-mapping-diagnostic', '--out', str(out), '--profile', 'VeryHigh', '--dop', '16', '--budget-ms', '60000', '--search-mode', 'Evaluate', '--nodes', '25000', '--beam', '135', '--card-branches', '72', '--pile-branches', '42', '--hand-branches', '54', '--enable-no-gc-region', '--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes', '16']
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(args, indent=2) + '\n')
    begin = time.monotonic()
    with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(args, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=120)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=10)
            raise
    if code:
        raise RuntimeError(scene + ' failed: ' + str(code))
    d = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
    assert d['status'] == 'Passed'
    counters = json.loads((out / 'mapping-categories.json').read_text())
    print(json.dumps(dict(scene=scene, processWallSeconds=time.monotonic()-begin, counters=counters)), flush=True)
print('MAPPING_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE', flush=True)
